===Etymology 1===
Verb from {{inh|en|enm|fallen}}, from {{inh|en|ang|feallan|t=to fall, fail, decay, die, attack}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*fallan|t=to fall}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*fallaną|t=to fall}}, from {{inh|en|ine-pro|*h₃elh₁-|t=to collapse, fall; to destroy}}.
{{col-top|2|cog}}
Cognate with {{cog|sco|faw|t=to fall}}, {{cog|yol|vale}}, {{m|yol|vall}}, {{m|yol|vole|t=to fall}}, {{cog|frr|faal}}, {{m|frr|fåle|t=to fall}}, {{cog|stq|faale|t=to fall}}, {{cog|fy|falle|t=to fall}}, {{cog|bar|foin|t=to fall}}, {{cog|cim|ballan}}, {{m|cim|vallan|t=to fall}}, {{cog|nl|vallen|t=to fall}}, {{cog|de,nds|fallen|t=to fall}}, {{cog|lb|falen|t=to fall}}, {{cog|yi|פֿאַלן|t=to fall}}, {{cog|da|falde|t=to fall}}, {{cog|fo,is,sv|falla|t=to fall}}, {{cog|nb|falle|t=to fall}}, {{cog|nn|falla}}, {{m|nn|falle|t=to fall}}; also {{cog|la|aboleō|t=to destroy; to die}}, {{cog|grc|ὄλλῡμι|t=to destroy; to lose}}, {{cog|hy|եղեռն|t=crime; calamity, catastrophe; slaughter}}, {{cog|lt|pùlti|t=to fall; to attack, assault}}.

Noun from {{inh|en|enm|fal}}, {{m|enm|fall}}, {{m|enm|falle}}, from {{inh|en|ang|feall}}, {{m|ang|ġefeall|t=a falling, fall}} and {{inh|en|ang|fealle|t=trap, snare}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*fallą}}, {{m|gem-pro|*fallaz|t=a fall, trap}}. Cognate with {{cog|yol|vall|t=fall}}, {{cog|nl|val|t=fall}}, {{cog|de|Fall|t=fall}}, {{cog|da|fald|t=fall}}, {{cog|fo,is,nb,nn,sv|fall|t=fall}}.
{{col-bottom}}

Sense of "autumn" is attested by the 1660s in [[England]] as a shortening of ''[[fall of the leaf]]'' (1540s), from the falling of leaves during this season. Along with ''autumn'', it mostly replaced the older name ''[[harvest]]'' as that name began to be associated strictly with the act of harvesting. Compare ''[[spring]]'', which began as a shortening of “spring of the leaf”.

# {{lb|en|heading|intransitive}} ''To be moved downwards.''
## To move to a lower position under the effect of [[gravity]].
##: {{ux|en|Thrown from a cliff, the stone '''fell''' 100 feet before hitting the ground.}}
##: {{ux|en|I '''fell''' unconscious on the floor.}}

|passage=There was a neat hat-and-umbrella stand, and the stranger's weary feet '''fell''' soft on a good, serviceable dark-red drugget, which matched in colour the flock-paper on the walls.}}
## To come down, to [[drop]] or [[descend]].
##: {{ux|en|The rain '''fell''' at dawn.}}
##* {{quote-book|en|year=1920|author=w:Herman Cyril McNeile|title=w:Bulldog Drummond|chapter=1
|passage=Her eyes '''fell''' on the table, and she advanced into the room wiping her hands on her apron.}}
##* {{quote-journal|en|author=Rory Smith|title=IQ scores are falling and have been for decades, new study finds|magazine=w:CNN|url=https://www.cnn.com/2018/06/13/health/falling-iq-scores-study-intl|date=2018-06-13|passage=The study not only showed IQ variance between children the same parents, but because the authors had the IQ scores of various parents, it demonstrated that parents with higher IQs tended to have more kids, ruling out the dysgenic fertility theory as a driver of '''falling''' IQ scores and highlighting the role of environmental factors instead.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260402133215/https://www.cnn.com/2018/06/13/health/falling-iq-scores-study-intl|archivedate=2 April 2026}}

|passage=Once or twice a noise '''fell''' upon his quick ear, and we halted, he standing revolver in hand in an attitude of defense. Each time, however, we ascertained that we had no occasion for alarm, the noise being made by some animal or bird  ...}}
##* {{quote-text|en|year=1904|author=Bram Stoker|title=The Jewel of Seven Stars|page=248
|passage=And then a sudden calm '''fell''' on us like a cloud of fear. There! on the table, lay the Jewel of Seven Stars, shining and sparkling with lurid light, as though each of the seven points of each of the seven stars gleamed through blood!}}

|passage=The horse wrangler, a tall, bronzed-face man, waved to the wagon driver. The driver laughed. {{...}} The canvas cover rolled up suddenly and a terrible noise '''fell''' over the desert.}}

##: {{ux|en|He '''fell''' to the floor and begged for mercy.}}

Modern society may not have done anything about war. But peace is a lot more peaceful.}}
